skill_name: Identify and explain 3 important themes of an epic poem.
workflow: Three important themes of Beowulf are heroism, fate, and revenge. Heroism is reflected throughout the poem through Beowulf’s fights with monsters such as Grendel and Grendel’s mother. Beowulf’s strength and courage show him to be a true hero, as well as his willingness to lay down his life for his people.
